title: Presenter profiles: flex cards, CSS grid, margin-auto column, centred pagination
stressor: sub-cell-inset alignment from flex, grid, and margin-auto box centring
notes: Self-contained single page, all CSS inline, no script, no network URLs. Designed for a 960x640 viewport (120x40 at 8x16). Exercises the sub-cell-inset alignment class that box centring creates. A flex row centred with justify-content:center holds three profile cards, each with a centred caption of distinctive text (Popey minds the mailbag, Mark keeps the calendar, Wimpy runs the desk). A CSS-grid section centred with justify-content:center holds three stat tiles with centred labels. A margin:0 auto fixed-width column centres a short passage. A centred pagination row holds five short numeric links. Paddings and widths are deliberately off 8-pixel multiples (13, 21, 37 pixel insets; 213, 187, 533 pixel widths) so the centred boxes land at sub-cell left edges, and the tightened placement gate fails without the overlay first-writer guard and sub-cell background recompose. White background, dark text. British English copy.

placement_gate.reason: Scoped tighten to 0.3 cells mean right-edge error, well under the global 0.5 default. The centred boxes land at sub-cell left edges, so the overlay first-writer-wins guard and the sub-cell background recompose must both hold for the mean to stay low. The value covers all three placement legs on the current build: 120x40 and 240x48 sit near 0.25, and the real-geometry 158x86 leg (fractional 8.101 CSS-pixel cell, layout_scale 1.975) measures 0.251, a hair over the former 0.25 cap. Latin max and drifted defaults are unchanged. The paint-referenced displacement leg carries no override and is the honest arbiter.
